load fails loudly when QuestDB rejects lines
context: Related done item perf-questdb-influxdb-load-20261030. Pre-existing. Not fixed by the verifier.
description:
Found by live verification of #3952 (perf-questdb-influxdb-load-20261030) on origin/develop 525361b2f8, questdb/questdb:10.0.1, loading_method=ilp, TPC-H SF0.01.

Expected: lineitem loads 60175 rows (l_shipdate designated timestamp, l_commitdate and l_receiptdate as timestamps).
Actual: lineitem has 0 rows and the load reports SUCCESS. QuestDB log: `LineWalAppender could not write line protocol measurement [tableName=lineitem ... column: l_commitdate; cast error from protocol type: STRING to column type: TIMESTAMP`. The ILP builder (_ilp_lines_from_strings in benchbox/platforms/questdb.py) converts only the designated column from TPCH_TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS to epoch nanoseconds; every other date column is quoted as a string, and QuestDB rejects the line and drops the connection. Same on the pre-#3952 commit 7aa4a8b391 (0 rows), so not a regression. Logs /tmp/live-verify-questdb-check.log, /tmp/live-verify-questdb-check-base3952.log, /tmp/live-verify-questdb-load.log.

Suspected: _ilp_lines_from_strings / _ilp_field_values (need per-column type awareness from SHOW COLUMNS, emitting timestamp columns as `<epoch_micros>t` or nanosecond integers).
